verse: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
verse_spoken: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I come to you this morning asking you to strengthen my faith.
You know the places where my trust has grown weak and my hope feels thin.
Help me believe your promises even when I cannot yet see them.
When doubt whispers that nothing will change, remind me that you are still at work.
Turn my eyes from my circumstances and fix them on your faithfulness.
Let my faith be more than words; let it shape how I live today.
Give me courage to take the next step, even before I see the whole path.
Strengthen everyone praying with me whose faith feels small right now.
Thank you that even faith as small as a mustard seed is enough in your hands.
